name: Historic Ensemble of the Potala Palace, Lhasa
description: The Potala Palace rises 13 stories up Marpo Ri, the Red Mountain, in the middle of Lhasa, about 3,700 metres above sea level. Home to the Dalai Lamas from 1649 until 1959, its white and deep-red walls hold more than 1,000 rooms and some 200,000 statues. The listing also covers the ancient Jokhang Temple and the Norbulingka summer palace.
